command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# #997 MIGRATION — MIG-03. First mutation of this lane, and the smallest one available: it ADDS a
# native Ollama under D:\HermesServices\ (the convention this machine already uses for HERMES
# services -- D:\HermesServices\williamos-hermes-agent) and changes nothing that already exists.
# Nothing is superseded here. The container definition, the compose file, the model stores and both
# GPUs are untouched by this step. Rollback is therefore exactly "remove the directory this step
# created", and the directory is recorded as absent beforehand so that claim is checkable.
#
# The download runs under a one-shot Scheduled Task rather than inline: a 1.4 GB fetch outlives the
# session timeouts, and Task Scheduler is the execution path on this box that does not silently lose
# its output (see the lab's own HermesLabHealth / HermesVolumeBackup tasks).

$root = 'D:\HermesServices\ollama'
$stage = Join-Path $root '_install'

Write-Output '--- ROLLBACK-BEFORE ---'
Write-Output "root_exists_before=$(Test-Path $root)"
Write-Output "hermesservices_exists=$(Test-Path 'D:\HermesServices')"
Get-ChildItem 'D:\HermesServices' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, Mode, LastWriteTimeUtc | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 120
Write-Output "ROLLBACK_PROCEDURE=Remove-Item -Recurse -Force '$root'   # restores the pre-step state exactly, because the path did not exist"
Write-Output "d_free_gb_before=$([math]::Round((Get-Volume -DriveLetter D).SizeRemaining / 1GB, 2))"

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $stage | Out-Null

$fetch = @'
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$stage = 'D:\HermesServices\ollama\_install'
$log = Join-Path $stage 'fetch.log'
function L($m) { "$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')) $m" | Add-Content $log }
try {
    L "start"
    $rel = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://api.github.com/repos/ollama/ollama/releases/latest' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 60
    $j = $rel.Content | ConvertFrom-Json
    L "tag=$($j.tag_name)"
    $j.tag_name | Set-Content (Join-Path $stage 'tag.txt')
    $zipAsset = $j.assets | Where-Object { $_.name -eq 'ollama-windows-amd64.zip' }
    $sumAsset = $j.assets | Where-Object { $_.name -match 'sha256|checksum' }
    if ($sumAsset) {
        Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $sumAsset[0].browser_download_url -OutFile (Join-Path $stage 'checksums.txt') -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 120
        L "checksums=$($sumAsset[0].name)"
    } else { L "checksums=NONE_PUBLISHED" }
    $zip = Join-Path $stage 'ollama-windows-amd64.zip'
    L "downloading $($zipAsset.browser_download_url) expect=$($zipAsset.size)"
    & curl.exe -L --fail --silent --show-error -o $zip $zipAsset.browser_download_url 2>&1 | Add-Content $log
    L "curl_rc=$LASTEXITCODE size=$((Get-Item $zip).Length)"
    if ((Get-Item $zip).Length -ne $zipAsset.size) { throw "size mismatch: got $((Get-Item $zip).Length) want $($zipAsset.size)" }
    $h = (Get-FileHash $zip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
    L "sha256=$h"
    $h | Set-Content (Join-Path $stage 'downloaded.sha256')
    $target = 'D:\HermesServices\ollama\dist'
    if (Test-Path $target) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $target }
    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
    [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::ExtractToDirectory($zip, $target)
    L "extracted"
    Remove-Item $zip -Force
    L "zip_removed"
    L "done"
} catch {
    L "FAIL $($_.Exception.Message)"
    exit 1
}
'@
Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $stage 'fetch-ollama.ps1') -Value $fetch -Encoding UTF8
Write-Output "fetch_script_sha256=$((Get-FileHash (Join-Path $stage 'fetch-ollama.ps1') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower())"

Write-Output '--- REGISTER-ONESHOT-TASK ---'
$name = 'WilliamOS-MIG-997-FetchOllama'
Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $name -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' -Argument "-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$stage\fetch-ollama.ps1`""
$principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId 'SYSTEM' -LogonType ServiceAccount -RunLevel Highest
$settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Hours 1)
Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $name -Action $action -Principal $principal -Settings $settings -Description '#997 one-shot: fetch native Ollama standalone package' | Out-Null
Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $name
Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
$t = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $name
Write-Output "task_state=$($t.State)"
Write-Output "task_last_result=$((Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName $name).LastTaskResult)"
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
